output.summary: Review 1 of 1e9d1d8..4a84203: not ready. C1: an evil merge commit pushed to a Story base after the check passes prepareStoryMerge as current (rev-list --no-merges) and reaches main unchecked where a repo has no Story checks (verified by a scratch test). C2: Tasks added after a repo merged never reach main; reportVerify wipes the repo records, and ensureStoryPr/mergeStoryPr return the old MERGED PR without checking its head, so the Story ends done. I1: a merge refused because the head moved is handed instead of re-verified. I2: a persistent gh error blocks every Task claim and is not visible. I3: the restart re-check has no test. I4: Stories at 승인 대기 from 4a have no commits and cannot be finished. Minors: the record rename after a crash, fork PRs, a handed PR left open on cancel, and docs.

evaluation.feedback: Implement attempt 2. C1: accept a Story base tip other than the verified commit only as a first-parent chain of clean two-parent merges whose second parent is in the base branch and whose tree equals git merge-tree --write-tree of its parents; else moved. C2: ensureStoryPr reuses a merged PR only when its head is the current tip, else opens a new one, and mergeStoryPr refuses a merged PR at another head; addTasks on an approved Story ends the approval and drops the merged records of the repos it adds Tasks to; reportVerify keeps merged records; re-read the approval before each merge. I1: a refused merge whose Story base tip moved goes back to the check. I2: a failing Story does not hold the claim tick (ran false, next Story) and its reason is shown on the Story page (finishReport problem). I3: tests for the restart re-check and C2. I4: team finish asks the Hub to check again a Story at 승인 대기 without commits. M1: the already-approved branch renames the matching record. M2: drop cross-repository PRs in lookUp. M3/M4: recorded as limits and in docs.
